task_completed.description: True when the assistant completed the task correctly within its intended scope, even if that scope ends in human handoff.

booking_succeeded.description: True only when a booking was actually created.

wrong_tool_usage.description: True when the wrong tool was used, used too early, or used in the wrong branch.

missing_required_data.description: True when the assistant failed because required booking or handoff data was missing.

repeated_question.description: True when the assistant re-asked for information that had already been provided clearly.

unsupported_claim.description: True when the assistant made a claim it could not support, for example promising a booking or handoff before tool success.

needs_human_handoff.description: True when the appropriate outcome is or was receptionist follow-up rather than full automation.
